_readme: The places a mission can go. Each destination has an id (for example mars_orbit) and a list of facts. Every fact is written as { "value": ..., "source": ... } so you can see where it came from. A source is a link to NASA, a written game-design choice, or the word PLACEHOLDER (made up for now; a student replaces it before the final submission). arrival_type = how the spacecraft ends its trip: "orbit" (circle the planet), "surface" (land) or "flyby" (fly past). crew = true if people travel on a ship that carries the spacecraft you build. The words on the screen (names, descriptions) are in data/story.json.

arrival_type.source: Game-design choice: this mission is a Mars orbiter, like NASA's Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO), which circled Mars to map it.

crew.source: Written game-design choice by Kaleb (AGENT_SOURCE.md section 2, 2026-11-10): Mars missions have a crew on a ship that carries the spacecraft the player built.
